proposal.rationale: No-cost rearrangement retaining every item: place the sofa against the wall opposite the entry, reposition the coffee table in front, and move the lounge chair to the left wall. Compared three checked candidates with equal space and entry-access measurements; choose the first. Living-room largest clear rectangle increases from 5 × 2.3 m (11.5 m²) to 4.75 × 2.9 m (13.775 m²): greater area and depth, but 0.25 m narrower. Measured free area changes from 36.675 to 36.93 m². Entry-to-sofa access improves from 0.45 to 0.60 m; entry routes to the kitchen and bedroom remain 0.85 m. Trade-off: the lounge chair has zero rear pull-out clearance against the wall. Existing dining, olive-tree and bedroom access problems remain. Purchase cost 0 AMD. Preview only, pending customer acceptance.
